name: Sliver Hivelord
description: Sliver who returned Yisan and Jalira to human form and let them leave.

description_citations.text: "Yisan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jalira and Yisan, transformed into slivers, fight to keep their minds against the hive's hum and will of the hivelord.
timeline.quote: They lose each other, forgetting who they are.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: They reach the central chamber where the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and, naked, take clothing and treasure while the hivelord does nothing.
timeline.quote: slowly procured as many coins and treasures as they and their pilfered clothes could carry

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Jalira and Yisan are transformed into slivers, then restored by a Sliver Hivelord.
timeline.quote: they found themselves transformed into slivers

citation.text: "Jalira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the sliver caves Yisan and Jalira are transformed into slivers and join the Hum; the Sliver Hivelord returns them to human form.
timeline.quote: when the Sliver Hivelord crossed paths with them, they found themselves returning to their normal human selves

citation.text: "Yisan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The two are allowed to take loot and leave; Jalira goes to Martyne while Yisan stays to study the slivers, mimicking their hum.
timeline.quote: Yisan opted to skip out on his share and instead stay in the Skep to study the creatures.

citation.text: "Yisan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The hive follows the will of the hivelord, its liege.
relations.quote: Hastric had mentioned it was the source of the slivers, their liege.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

pages_say.description: A massive sliver twenty times the size of a man that is the source and liege of the slivers, and who lets the pair take its hoarded treasure.

citation.text: "The Bard and the Biologist" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jul 2014.

pages_say.description: Sliver leader who stripped Jalira and Yisan of sliver bodies.

citation.text: "Jalira". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Sliver who returned Yisan and Jalira to human form and let them leave.
